summary: Jest suite runs cleanly (59 suites, 562 tests) with strong coverage and broad @supports usage; remaining risk is mainly low-branch paths and lack of explicit e2e coverage.
reasoning: `npm test` passes (59 suites, 562 tests) with stable execution across rules, utils, config, maintenance, and CLI integration tests.
Coverage is high overall (96.75% statements/lines, 98.39% functions, 86.41% branches) with configured global thresholds met.
Tests focus on behavior using RuleTester valid/invalid cases plus CLI spawnSync workflows and maintenance CLI exercises with readable assertions.
@supports annotations are pervasive (197 instances) and map to many stories/requirements, enabling traceability.
No explicit e2e layer exists and a handful of entrypoint/helper modules have low branch coverage, leaving conditional paths less exercised.

improvement_path.item: Add branch-focused tests for low-coverage entrypoints/helpers (e.g., `src/index.ts`, `src/rules/require-traceability.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/prefer-implements-inline.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/require-test-traceability-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/function-annotation-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/branch-annotation-switch-helpers.ts`).
improvement_path.rationale: Raises confidence in currently under-exercised conditional logic.

improvement_path.item: Introduce a small end-to-end smoke test that runs the plugin against a fixture project via the ESLint CLI.
improvement_path.rationale: Adds full-stack validation beyond unit/integration coverage.

improvement_path.item: Normalize @supports usage in tests that reference fixtures or examples to ensure consistent story/req mapping (avoid duplicate fixture paths).
improvement_path.rationale: Improves traceability signal quality and reduces mapping ambiguity.

rationale: Package exports compiled plugin entrypoints (`main`/`types` -> `lib`) indicating a distributable library.
Peer dependency on `eslint` and tests focused on ESLint rules/configs align with a plugin library.
A maintenance CLI exists under `bin`, but the primary deliverable is the ESLint plugin.
